status_summary: No EPA rulemaking, notice or guidance reassessing its radiation standards or the linear no-threshold model was found. On 2025-05-23 Executive Order 14300 directed the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, not EPA, to reconsider reliance on the linear no-threshold model, consulting with the Department of Defense, the Department of Energy and EPA. On 2026-07-15 the Nuclear Regulatory Commission proposed revisions to its radiation protection standards in response to that order; this is a parallel action by another agency and is not credited as EPA progress.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14300, Ordering the Reform of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, was signed; section 5(b) directs the NRC to reconsider reliance on the linear no-threshold model and ALARA, consulting with DOD, DOE and EPA (published 2025-05-29, 90 FR 22587).

The Nuclear Regulatory Commission published a proposed rule, Reforming and Modernizing the NRC's Radiation Protection Framework, citing section 5(b) of Executive Order 14300; comments were due 2026-08-31.

title: Align EPA radiation standards with other agencies and reassess linear no-threshold
uncertainties: The NRC proposed rule was read only to character 100000 of about 126000, and its truncated part may mention EPA. An EPA page on its LNT perspective shows a May 2026 update date, but its content did not indicate a reassessment, so it is not a timeline event. The NRC action is a different agency's action; it is noted as a parallel action and the record is staged not_started because the recommendation is addressed to EPA's own standards. Searches run: Federal Register API (linear no-threshold; radiation protection standards), plus two web searches on EPA radiation LNT and 40 CFR part 190. No EPA Federal Register document on radiation standards since 2025 surfaced in the first 10 results of the radiation query, which were mostly unrelated air documents; a deeper listing was not read. The review ran one additional web search on EPA radiation standards and the linear no-threshold model in 2026; results showed only the NRC proposal and 2018 coverage of an earlier EPA science proposal. The page 427 linear no-threshold element also overlaps c13-05, which tracks rejection of precautionary default models.
